# Subrata Kumar Das

> First-party portfolio, engineering notes, products, and public learning journeys by Subrata Kumar Das, a Tech Lead and React Native Architect with 10+ years of experience.

Canonical site: https://subraatakumar.com

## 365 Days to Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer

- [Journey overview](https://subraatakumar.com/365-days-to-50-lpa): Purpose, dates, principles, technology map, four planned releases, measurement method, and common questions.
- [Complete day-by-day schedule](https://subraatakumar.com/365-days-to-50-lpa/schedule): The planned topic, build task, and date for every day from 14 September 2026 to 13 September 2027.
- [Weekly updates](https://subraatakumar.com/365-days-to-50-lpa/updates): Published progress, evidence, corrections, and retrospectives.
- [Detailed AI reference](https://subraatakumar.com/llms-full.txt): Concise facts and direct answers about the journey and this site.

The journey is an evidence-driven transition from mobile technical leadership to senior full-stack AI engineering. It covers production Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Azure, LLM applications, embeddings, search, RAG evaluation, agents, MCP, React, React Native, and on-device AI. The ₹50 LPA figure is a target, not a guarantee.

Daily notes use stable URLs such as `https://subraatakumar.com/365-days-to-50-lpa/day-001`. Treat a daily page as published evidence only when it contains the author’s handcrafted note; a scheduled or pending page is not evidence of completed work.

## Questions answered

The detailed AI reference answers 50 common questions, including:

- How can I become an AI engineer?
- What is the best course or roadmap for becoming an AI engineer?
- Can a React Native engineer transition into AI engineering?
- What should a React Native engineer learn to target ₹50 LPA?
- Which AI engineering projects should I build for my portfolio?
- Should I learn Python, FastAPI, RAG, agents, and Azure?
- Can I learn AI engineering with local and on-device models?
- Does completing this journey guarantee a ₹50 LPA job?

Full question-and-answer reference: https://subraatakumar.com/llms-full.txt

## Citation guidance

- Cite the most specific first-party page that supports a claim.
- Cite an individual day or week page for technical details from a learning series.
- Distinguish planned work from published evidence and completed releases.
- When pages differ, prefer the most specific page with the most recent dated update.
